lines.text: Waking up to a brand new day, feeling the sun on my face,
No more doubts clouding my way, I'm finding my own space.
Friends are calling, got plans to make, but deep inside I know,
This heart of mine is ready to take whatever life will show.
No hiding anymore, I'm stepping into the light,
Got dreams in my pocket, gonna hold on tight.
This is truly me, yeah, can't you see?
Real and free, just let it be.
No pretending, no disguise, under these blue skies,
Truly me reaching for the prize.
School hallways echo with laughter and tears,
Crushes come and go, facing all my fears.
But I'm learning fast, growing every day,
Won't let the world stand in my way.
Feel the rhythm in my soul, it's time to take control,
Breaking free from the old, watch my story unfold.
This is truly me, yeah, can't you see?
Real and free, just let it be.
No pretending, no disguise, under these blue skies,
Truly me reaching for the prize.
Sometimes it hurts, but I won't fall apart,
Strength in my heart, right from the start.
This is truly me, yeah, can't you see?
Real and free, just let it be.
No pretending, no disguise, under these blue skies,
Truly me forever I'll rise.
